claims.text: Two parts: the facial bones and the brain case (cranial vault).
claims.quote: It is subdivided into the facial bones and the brain case, or cranial vault

claims.text: Mandible: the only moveable bone of the skull.
claims.quote: The 22nd bone is the mandible (lower jaw), which is the only moveable bone of the skull.

claims.text: Frontal bone: the single bone of the forehead.
claims.quote: The frontal bone is the single bone that forms the forehead.

claims.text: Parietal bone: most of the upper lateral skull.
claims.quote: The parietal bone forms most of the upper lateral side of the skull

claims.text: Temporal bone: the lower lateral skull.
claims.quote: The temporal bone forms the lower lateral side of the skull

claims.text: Occipital bone: the posterior skull and posterior base of the cranial cavity.
claims.quote: The occipital bone is the single bone that forms the posterior skull and posterior base of the cranial cavity

claims.text: Sphenoid bone: a single midline bone forming the anterior walls and floor of the middle cranial fossa.
claims.quote: the sphenoid bone is a single midline bone that forms the anterior walls and floor of the middle cranial fossa.

claims.text: Cranial fossae: the skull base has a shallow anterior, a middle and a deep posterior cranial fossa.
claims.quote: The base of the brain case, which forms the floor of cranial cavity, is subdivided into the shallow anterior cranial fossa, the middle cranial fossa, and the deep posterior cranial fossa.

claims.text: Sutures: immobile joints between adjacent skull bones.
claims.quote: A suture is an immobile joint between adjacent bones of the skull.

claims.text: Top of the skull: the coronal and sagittal sutures.
claims.quote: The two suture lines seen on the top of the skull are the coronal and sagittal sutures.

claims.text: Nasal septum: the perpendicular plate of the ethmoid above and the vomer below.
claims.quote: The upper portion of the nasal septum is formed by the perpendicular plate of the ethmoid bone and the lower portion is the vomer bone.

claims.text: Conchae: the middle and superior nasal conchae are part of the ethmoid bone.
claims.quote: Located just above the inferior concha is the middle nasal concha, which is part of the ethmoid bone. A third bony plate, also part of the ethmoid bone, is the superior nasal concha.
